title: Piggy in the Middle
hook: George 扔球总被妈妈拦下，Peppa 笑得停不下来，直到妈妈说：别这样逗弟弟。

cells.a: He was playing with his ball in the garden.

cells.q: What did Peppa do to George?
cells.a: She took his ball and threw it away. She was cheeky.

cells.q: Who was the piggy in the middle?
cells.a: Mummy Pig was. She stood between Peppa and George.
cells.cn: 是猪妈妈，她站在两个孩子中间。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig tell George?
cells.a: She told him to throw the ball to Peppa.
cells.cn: 她让 George 把球扔给 Peppa。

cells.q: Could George throw the ball past Mummy?
cells.a: No, he could not throw it past Mummy Pig.
George did. Mummy caught the ball and said, “You're the piggy!”
cells.cn: 轮到 George 了，妈妈接住球这么说。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig tell Peppa?
cells.a: She said, “Peppa, you shouldn't tease George like that.”
cells.cn: 她说：“Peppa，不该这样取笑弟弟。”

cells.a: He said he just gave George a helping hand.
cells.cn: 他说自己只是帮了 George 一把。

cells.a: She loves catching the ball and playing together.
cells.cn: 她喜欢接球，也喜欢一起玩。
